requirements_summary: Workload: reranking + transformer-based support agent; expected peak throughput ~200 req/s, latency SLO 150ms p95 for short-chat and 50ms p50 for embeddings. Must run in private VPC. Network security: prefer AWS PrivateLink endpoints or managed VPC peering (no internet egress). Need detailed firewall/security group rules (ports, CIDR ranges), route table updates, and explicit egress via company proxy. Egress controls: deny default outbound, allow only to proxy + Redwood PrivateLink IP ranges. IP allowlists: staging and prod separate lists; require static IPs for webhook callbacks. KMS integration: HSM-backed customer-managed keys, key rotation policy, tight IAM mapping. Audit logging: request-level logs for 90 days, immutable logs delivered to their Splunk/S3 with object-level retention and ability to export for audits. Data residency: US regions only. Authentication: SSO (SAML) + mTLS between their VPC and Redwood endpoints. Fallbacks: model variant fallback permitted within same residency boundary; no fallback to hosted public endpoints. Operational asks: can provide a minimal allowed CIDR list, Terraform module for peering and PrivateLink, and prebuilt firewall rule set for NetOps.
